name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After § 11 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 11a. Requests clarification from the Commission regarding whether any EU funds, whether disbursed directly to Ukrainian state institutions or indirectly via implementing partners, international organisations or non-governmental organisation (NGO) channels, are implicated in the corruption cases currently under investigation in Ukraine; asks the Commission to put in place strong oversight and rigorous audit procedures for all assistance provided to Ukraine, especially in the light of the recent cases of corruption and misappropriation in the country, which make it all the more necessary to ensure strict and robust control over future disbursements;
